title: য, ই, অ, ড় and ট
focus: New: য ই অ ড় ট
body:
# Lesson 7: য, ই, অ, ড় and ট

য is a second j letter (same sound as জ). ই and অ are vowel letters for word starts. ড় is the flapped r in বাড়ি. ট is the hard English-style t.

| Script | Sound | Note |
|---|---|---|
| য | jo (j) | Same sound as জ in Kolkata. No dot; with a dot it's য়. |
| ই | i (vowel letter) | Used after another vowel too: বই, চাই. |
| অ | o (vowel letter) | আ is this letter plus the aa bar. Ollie is spelt অলি. |
| ড় | ro (flapped r) | Dot below. Romanized r, so বাড়ি is bari. |
| ট | to (hard t) | Hard t like English t; ত is the soft one. |

## How they combine

ই follows a vowel or starts a word: ব + ই = বই **boi**. অ is the bare o: অলি **Ollie**. ড় sounds like r with a tongue flick, and is romanized r: বাড়ি **bari**.

## Read these

Cover the right side, read the script aloud, then check.

- যাব → jabo: I will go
- বই → boi: book
- চাই → chai: I want
- অলি → Ollie: Ollie (the cat)
- বাড়ি → bari: house, home
- বড় → boro: big
- বিড়াল → beral: cat
- একটা → ekta: a, one

cards.Meaning: consonant j (antostho jo), with built-in o
cards.Notes: Same sound as জ in Kolkata. No dot; with a dot it's য়.

cards.Meaning: independent vowel i, at a word start or after a vowel
cards.Notes: Used after another vowel too: বই, চাই.

cards.Meaning: independent vowel o, the built-in vowel written on its own
cards.Notes: আ is this letter plus the aa bar. Ollie is spelt অলি.

cards.Meaning: consonant flapped r (ড with a dot), with built-in o
cards.Notes: Dot below. Romanized r, so বাড়ি is bari.

cards.Meaning: consonant hard t (tongue curled back), with built-in o
cards.Notes: Hard t like English t; ত is the soft one.

cards.Example: আমি কাল যাব ami kal jabo: I'll go tomorrow
cards.Notes: য j + া aa + ব b: final o spoken, like খাব.

cards.Example: আমার বই amar boi: my book
cards.Notes: ব b + ই i: ই because it follows a vowel.

cards.Example: আমি চা চাই ami cha chai: I want tea
অলি খুব ভালো Ollie khub bhalo: Ollie is very good
আমার বাড়ি amar bari: my house
cards.Notes: ব b + া aa + ড় r + ি i.

cards.Example: বাড়িটা বড় bari-ta boro: the house is big
cards.Notes: ব b + ড় r: TRAP, final o spoken (boro).

cards.Example: একটা বিড়াল ekta beral: a cat
cards.Notes: ব b + ি i + ড় r + া aa + ল l: TRAP, spelt bi- but said be-.

cards.Example: একটা বই ekta boi: a book
cards.Notes: এ e + ক k + ট t + া aa: k has no vowel.
